start: 👋 Hello {name}! I'm {bot} — a group management bot for Telegram. I speak both Myanmar and English. ➤ Add me to your group, make me an admin, then send /help to see everything I can do. 🌐 Language / ဘာသာစကား:
start_pm: I'm a group management bot. Add me to a group and give me admin rights so I can protect it.
help_mod: Moderation /ban /unban /kick /mute /unmute /tmute /tban — reply to a user or give @user /warn /unwarn /warns /resetwarns — warning system /setwarnlimit 3 · /setwarnmode ban|kick|mute /purge — delete up to the replied message · /del /pin /unpin /permapin /report — report to admins /approve /unapprove /approved — trusted members /promote /demote /adminlist /admincache
help_antispam: Anti-spam /lock url sticker gif forward media … · /unlock · /locks · /locktypes /addblocklist <word> · /unblocklist · /blocklist · /blocklistmode delete|warn|mute|kick|ban|tmute|tban /setflood 5 · /setfloodtimer 5 10s · /setfloodmode tmute 10m · /clearflood on /captcha on · /captchamode button|math · /captchakick on · /captcharules on /antiraid on · /raidtime 1h
help_other: Federations & utility /newfed <name> · /joinfed <id> · /fban /funban /fbanlist /export · /import (reply to a .json file) /settings — button panel · /lang my|en · /id · /info · /ping · /stats 💡 Tip: every command accepts reason text after the target.
lang_set: ✅ ဘာသာစကားကို မြန်မာ သတ်မှတ်ပြီးပါပြီ။
err_admin_only: ⛔ Only admins can use this command.
err_owner_only: ⛔ Only the group creator can use this command.
err_need_target: ⚠️ Reply to a user, or give @username / user id.
err_bot_needs_admin: ⚠️ Please make me an admin first (all rights).
err_generic: ⚠️ Couldn't do that — check my permissions (or that user may be an admin).
err_group_only: ⚠️ This command only works in a group.
target_is_admin: ⛔ That user is an admin, I can't do that.
purge_need_reply: ⚠️ Reply to the first message you want deleted, then send /purge.
pin_need_reply: ⚠️ Reply to the message you want pinned.
flood_set: ✅ Antiflood limit set to {n} consecutive messages.
clearflood_on: ✅ clearflood on — all flood messages will be deleted.
captcha_on:
✅ CAPTCHA enabled. New members must press the button.
⚠️ Welcome messages must be enabled (/welcome on).
captcha_kick_on: ✅ Unverified members will be kicked after {time}.
captcha_rules_on: ✅ Rules will be shown during CAPTCHA.
captcha_button: ✅ Click here to prove you're human
captcha_wrong: ❌ Wrong answer. Try again in a moment.
captcha_expired: ⌛ {user} didn't solve the CAPTCHA and was kicked. They can rejoin and try again.
antiraid_on: ✅ AntiRaid enabled. If too many people join at once, I'll lock the group temporarily.
antiraid_triggered: 🚨 AntiRaid — {n} members joined at once, group locked for {time}.
cleanwelcome_on: ✅ Old welcome messages will be deleted automatically.
cleanservice_on: ✅ Join/leave service messages will be deleted.
default_welcome: Hello {mention}! Welcome to {chatname} 🌸 Please read the rules with /rules.
default_goodbye: {mention} left the group. See you again 👋
notes_empty: ℹ️ No notes yet. Reply to a message with /save <name>.
note_need_content: ⚠️ No content — reply to a message with /save <name>.
rules_private_on: ✅ Rules will be sent in private only.
rules_private_off: ✅ Rules will be shown in the group.
rules_sent_pm: 📩 I sent the rules to your private chat.
fed_exists: ℹ️ A federation with that name already exists.
fban_done: 🏛 Banned {user} in {n} group(s) of the federation.
import_err: ⚠️ Couldn't read that file. It must be a .json produced by /export.
captcha_button_hint: 🔐 {user} — press the button below to verify and start chatting.
menu_title: 🌸 {bot} What should I do? Just tap a button below 👇 No commands to memorise.
menu_lang_pick: 🌐 ဘာသာစကား ရွေးပါ / Choose language
help_choose: 🛡️ Which topic? Tap a button below 👇
quick_title: 🚀 Easy setup — 4 steps 1️⃣ Add me to your group 2️⃣ Make me an admin (all rights) 3️⃣ Tap the buttons below to switch features on 👇 4️⃣ Done 🎉 Need more? Open ⚙️ Settings 💡 Only group admins can tap the on/off buttons.
added_group: 🌸 Thanks for adding {bot} to {chat}! ⚠️ Please make me an admin so I can work. Then tap the button below — 3 taps and you're set 👇
now_admin: ✅ Thanks for the admin rights! You can now switch on protections 👇
